clue.text: Tea for each side, and maybe fruit from No 10?

definitions.note: No 10 is the gooseberry bush entry, and a gooseberry is someone who tags along with a couple

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
per means for each, as in 'a pound per head'
the on side is one half of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A tea party with a cup each and some fruit, perhaps served at Downing Street.
explanation.walkthrough: No 10 looks like Downing Street but points to 10 across: the fruit there is the gooseberry, a slang name for an unwanted third person with a couple.
explanation.definitionFit: A gooseberry is the unwanted third party with a courting pair, which is just the role of a chaperone.

clue.text: Commission on diamonds demanded

parts.note: to charge someone with a task is to commission them
D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A fee charged for a deal on diamonds was demanded.
explanation.definitionFit: To have charged a price is to have demanded it as payment.

clue.text: Confirm the writer is English

parts.note: an author is a writer

explanation.surface: Someone checking that the author in question really is English.
explanation.definitionFit: To authorise something is to sanction or approve it formally.

clue.text: The case is dubious for the reversion of property

indicators.note: a dubious case is shaky and unsettled, so its letters are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A lawyer doubts a legal claim about property passing back to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: In old law, an escheat is land reverting to the Crown or lord when the holder dies without heirs.

clue.text: Old diesel processed plant's produce

indicators.note: processed means worked over and changed, so the letters of diesel are rearranged

explanation.surface: Old diesel fuel gets refined from something plants yield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old' must stay outside the anagram: the word processed is only the fuel, and the O leads the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Oilseed, such as rape or sunflower seed, is crop matter grown to be pressed for oil.

clue.text: Letter read out covering start on new project

parts.note: em is the letter M spelt out as it is spoken
bark is the covering of a tree

explanation.surface: Someone reads a letter aloud, covering the launch of a new venture.
explanation.definitionFit: To embark is to set out on an undertaking, as on a voyage.

clue.text: English group includes highlight for all and sundry

indicators.note: includes means the pair on either side takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: a body is a group of people, as in a governing body
a Very light is a flare fired high into the sky as a signal

explanation.surface: An English group includes a highlight that appeals to all.
explanation.walkthrough: A Very light is a coloured signal flare fired high from a pistol, hence 'highlight'; 'includes' has the English group wrap round it.
explanation.definitionFit: All and sundry is an idiom for every single person, without exception.

clue.text: One Cubist composition is a cracker

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so the letters are arranged anew

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A single Cubist painting is described as a cracker of a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A cracker is a thin, crisp baked wafer, a kind of savoury biscuit.

clue.text: He wants to have all his own way

definitions.text: He wants to have all his own way

parts.words: He wants to have all his own way
parts.note: read literally, a selfish motorist who wants the whole carriageway to himself

explanation.definitionFit: A road hog is a driver who hogs the road, not letting others share it.

clue.text: Enunciate clearly in broadcast of actual rite

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread and rearranged

explanation.surface: A priest speaks clearly when a real ceremony goes out on air.
explanation.definitionFit: To articulate is to pronounce each sound distinctly when speaking.

clue.text: Argue with Pole over a deck

definitions.meaning: to dispute or exchange blows in practice
a mast, boom or yard rising above a ship's deck

explanation.definitionFit: Sparring is trading verbal blows; separately, a spar is a strong wooden pole in a ship's rigging.

clue.text: See under, for child's place of birth

definitions.text: See under, for child's place of birth

parts.words: See under, for child's place of birth
parts.note: children asking where babies come from were told to look beneath a garden shrub

explanation.definitionFit: Old nursery lore told children that babies were found under a fruit shrub in the garden.

clue.text: Without a paper, fell silent and wandered about

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so these letters go round the paper

parts.note: an actor who dries forgets their lines and falls silent
FT is the Financial Times newspaper

explanation.surface: Lacking a newspaper, someone grew quiet and roamed aimlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' means outside here, not lacking. Actors who dry forget their lines and go silent.
explanation.definitionFit: To have drifted is to have moved aimlessly, roaming with no fixed course.

clue.text: Surveys included old women's make-up

parts.note: to eye something is to look it over, so eyes means surveys
had means included, as in 'the package had a manual'
W is an abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: Questionnaires covered older women's cosmetics.
explanation.definitionFit: This cosmetic is a coloured powder or cream applied to the eyelids.

clue.text: Sort of hospital in a country house

definitions.meaning: a ... hospital is a small rural hospital
a small dwelling in the countryside

explanation.definitionFit: A cottage is a small house in the country; a small local hospital is named after the same word.

clue.text: In early afternoon, people found temperature giving satisfaction

parts.note: at one o'clock is early in the afternoon
men means people, as in 'all men are mortal'

explanation.surface: After lunch some people discovered the weather pleasingly warm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In early afternoon' gives AT ONE as in 'at one o'clock', a phrase read as letters.
explanation.definitionFit: In theology, satisfaction is reparation for wrongdoing, the same as making amends.

clue.text: Drives, having a rendezvous with Serbian leader

parts.note: a rendezvous is a meeting place, a venue

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of Serbian

explanation.surface: Motoring trips that include a meeting with a Serbian politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Drives and avenues are both broad roads, often tree-lined.

clue.text: See a deer take off

parts.note: V stands for vide, Latin for see, in references
a moose is a large deer

explanation.surface: Spotting a deer, someone tells it to clear off.
explanation.definitionFit: Vamoose is slang meaning to leave hurriedly or clear off.

clue.text: Point to raise about the wind in N America

parts.note: north is a point of the compass

indicators.note: in a down clue raise means lift up, so the word below is read from the bottom up

parts.note: re is Latin-derived for about, concerning

explanation.surface: A suggestion to raise the matter of the winds of North America.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'raise' reads the word for about from the bottom up; 'to' and 'the' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A norther is a strong cold gale from the north sweeping across the southern US.

clue.text: Depression is nothing new in age

indicators.note: in means the two pieces sit inside the word for age

parts.note: a cycle is an age or long period
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A gloomy observation that nothing changes from one era to another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Depression' looks like gloom but is the weather sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A depression in meteorology is a region of low pressure, a rotating storm system.

clue.text: Relative is getting up dance in church

indicators.note: in places the turned dance inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: in a down clue getting up means rising, so the dance is read upward

parts.note: the tango is a dance

explanation.surface: A family member gets up to dance during a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'getting up' reads the dance from the bottom up, and 'in' sets it inside the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Cognate means related by blood or descent, and as a noun a kinsman.

clue.text: Girl, before engineer pinches her, rear, hides in this vessel

indicators.note: the engineer snatches the last letter of the girl's name and holds it inside
before puts the girl's name ahead of the engineer

parts.note: Coral is a girl's name
CE is a civil engineer

explanation.surface: A man pinches a girl's bottom, and she hides inside a little boat.
explanation.walkthrough: The comma-split 'pinches her, rear' has the engineer grab the girl's final letter. Coracles were covered with animal hides, so the definition is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: A coracle is a small round boat of wicker traditionally covered with animal skins.

clue.text: Literary piece European duke attempted

parts.note: an essay is a short piece of writing

explanation.surface: A European aristocrat tried his hand at writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To essay is an old word for to try, so essayed means tried.

clue.text: Demonstrating groups get notice of dismissal

definitions.meaning: read literally, protesting crowds who are on the march
an instruction to leave a job or place

explanation.definitionFit: Marching orders is an idiom for being told to go; literally, the phrase can name ranks on a protest march.

clue.text: My move — quiet!

definitions.note: used as an exclamation of surprise

parts.note: a go is a turn or move in a game
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: A player announces it is their turn and asks for silence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' looks like a possessive but is the exclamation, as in 'My, how you've grown!'
explanation.definitionFit: Both are mild exclamations of surprise.

clue.text: Depravity shown by each rude frolic

indicators.note: a frolic is a romp, so these letters gambol into a new order

explanation.surface: Moral corruption displayed in some crude romp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frolic' rearranges BY EACH RUDE; 'shown' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Debauchery is excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures, a kind of moral corruption.

clue.text: Israelite made a highly explosive mixture

parts.note: HE stands for high explosive
a brew is a mixture, as in a witches' brew

explanation.surface: Someone in ancient Israel concocted a dangerous blend of explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: Hebrew is another name for an Israelite, a member of the ancient Jewish people.

clue.text: Advanced amid retreating animals and showed mercy

indicators.note: amid puts the loaned money inside the turned animals
retreating means going backwards, so the word for animals is read in reverse

parts.note: deer are animals
to advance money is to lend it, so lent

explanation.surface: Advancing among fleeing creatures, a hunter decided to spare them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advanced' looks like moving forward but means loaned; 'retreating' runs the animals backwards and 'amid' sets the loan inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To have relented is to have softened and become less severe.
